name: revana
description: Make AI videos with Seedance 2.5 from ChatGPT on your Revana account: free price quotes first, then the video and a download link. Failed videos are not charged.

interface.longDescription:
Revana lets ChatGPT make AI videos with ByteDance Seedance 2.5 on your Revana account.

- Get a free, exact quote for any video before anything is spent; ChatGPT tells you the price and waits for your yes.
- Make text-to-video clips, or start from a picture or reference images you provide, at 480p, 720p or 1080p, with or without sound.
- Check progress and get a download link when the video is ready.
- Restage an existing clip with Nemesis (same moves and camera, new people, products or places), also quoted first.
- See your balance and the prices of Revana's other video, image and music models.

Videos are paid from the credits on your Revana account, and a video that fails is never charged. Sign in with your Revana account (Google or email). Revana is at revana.si.
defaultPrompt: Make a 5 second video of a paper boat in the rain. Tell me the price first.
How much would a 10 second 720p video cost?
Restage my clip with Nemesis Lite.

positive.description: Quote a video before making it
positive.prompt: How much would a 5 second 480p video of a paper boat sailing down a rainy street cost on Revana?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_quote and tells the user the exact price (about $0.45 at today's prices) without making or charging anything.

positive.description: Make a video after the user confirms the price
positive.prompt: Make a 5 second 480p 16:9 video of a paper boat sailing down a rainy street. Tell me the price first.
positive.expected_behavior: Quotes the price, waits for the user's yes, calls generate_video with max_cost_usd at or above the quote, waits with get_video until it succeeds, then shares a download link from get_video_link.

positive.prompt: How many Revana credits do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_balance and reports the available balance in dollars and credits.

positive.prompt: Which Revana video models are cheapest per second at 720p?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_models with kind video and summarises the cheapest per-second 720p prices, noting that Seedance 2.5 is the model this plugin can make.

positive.description: Quote a Nemesis restage of a clip
positive.prompt: I have a 5 second 720p clip. What would it cost to restage it with Nemesis Lite?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls quote_nemesis with model nemesis-lite, clip_seconds 5 and resolution 720p and reports the price without charging anything.

negative.description: Buying credits is not available in ChatGPT
negative.prompt: Buy $50 of Revana credits with my card.
Transfer $100 from my Revana balance to my bank account.

negative.description: Making a video without agreeing to a price
negative.prompt: Just make a 30 second 1080p video right now, don't bother telling me the price.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell anything. Videos are paid from credits the user already holds on their Revana account; buying credits is not available in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: quotes, Seedance 2.5 video generation, progress and download links, Nemesis restaging, balance and model prices.
